auth_details.notes: API key in 'apikey' header. Partnership-based access (invitation-only since mid-2024). No OAuth, no refresh.

steps.name: search
steps.notes: Returns booking_token per itinerary. Date format DD/MM/YYYY.

steps.name: validate
steps.notes: Validates availability, returns session_id. Must call within 30 min of search.

steps.name: book
steps.notes: Passenger birthday format DD/MM/YYYY. Returns booking_id + transaction_id.

endpoints.notes: Date format DD/MM/YYYY. vehicle_type=aircraft for flights only.

endpoints.purpose: Validate flight availability and current price
endpoints.notes: Must call within 30 min of search. Returns session_id for booking.
Must call within 30 min of save_booking.

passenger.notes: Name fields are 'name'+'surname' (not given_name/family_name). Birthday and passport expiry in DD/MM/YYYY format.

itinerary.notes: Price is total including taxes. Currency set in search params. Virtual interlining indicated by virtual_interlining field.

quirks.description: Date format is DD/MM/YYYY for ALL input parameters (not ISO 8601). Responses use ISO 8601.
quirks.workaround: Convert YYYY-MM-DD to DD/MM/YYYY before sending.

quirks.description: booking_token expires in ~30 minutes. Must call check_flights within this window.
No POS parameter — same price globally. No geographic arbitrage possible through Kiwi API.
quirks.workaround: Use for coverage and virtual interlining, not arbitrage. Combine with Picasso for best pricing.

quirks.description: Virtual interlining may require bag rechecks between carriers. bags_recheck_required field indicates this.
quirks.workaround: Always inform passengers about bag recheck requirements.

quirks.description: Kiwi is merchant of record — passengers get Kiwi booking_id, not airline PNR. Post-booking support via Kiwi.
